load-pdf-verify-page-count-facade.title: Load PDF and Verify Page Count
load-pdf-verify-page-count-facade.description: Demonstrates loading a PDF file with Aspose.Pdf and confirming successful loading by reading the document's page count.

check-pdf-encryption-and-toggle-protecti.title: Check PDF Encryption and Perform Encrypt/Decrypt
check-pdf-encryption-and-toggle-protecti.description: Demonstrates how to use Aspose.Pdf Facades to check if a PDF is encrypted, then encrypt an unprotected PDF or decrypt an encrypted one accordingly.

decrypt-pdf-owner-password.title: Decrypt PDF Using Owner Password
decrypt-pdf-owner-password.description: Loads an encrypted PDF with the owner password and saves an unencrypted copy of the document.

encrypt-pdf-256-aes.title: Encrypt PDF with 256‑bit AES and Passwords
encrypt-pdf-256-aes.description: Shows how to load a PDF, apply 256‑bit AES encryption with user and owner passwords and set permissions, then save the protected document.

encrypt-pdf-rc4-40.title: Encrypt PDF with RC4‑40 using Aspose.Pdf
encrypt-pdf-rc4-40.description: Shows how to load a PDF, apply RC4‑40 encryption with user and owner passwords, set permissions, and save the encrypted document.

encrypt-pdf-aes256-custom-privileges.title: Encrypt PDF with AES‑256 and Custom Permissions
encrypt-pdf-aes256-custom-privileges.description: Demonstrates how to load a PDF, apply AES‑256 encryption with user and owner passwords, set specific permissions, and save the encrypted document using Aspose.Pdf.

change-user-password-of-encrypted-pdf.title: Change User Password of Encrypted PDF While Preserving Settings
change-user-password-of-encrypted-pdf.description: Demonstrates opening an encrypted PDF with the existing user password, re‑encrypting it with a new user password while keeping the original owner password, permissions, and encryption algorithm, and then saving the result.

update-owner-password-pdf.title: Update Owner Password of a Protected PDF
update-owner-password-pdf.description: Demonstrates how to change the owner password of an encrypted PDF while keeping the user password and existing permissions unchanged, using AES‑256 encryption.

set-pdf-privileges-allow-printing-only.title: Allow Printing Only and Disallow Copying in PDF
set-pdf-privileges-allow-printing-only.description: Demonstrates how to encrypt a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, granting only printing permission while preventing content copying, and then saves the protected document.

set-pdf-privileges-allow-form-filling-di.title: Allow Form Filling While Disabling Document Assembly
set-pdf-privileges-allow-form-filling-di.description: Loads a PDF, grants only the FillForm permission (disabling DocumentAssembly and other privileges), encrypts the file with an owner password, and saves the result.

disable-copying-enable-printing-pdf.title: Disable Copying While Enabling Printing for PDF
disable-copying-enable-printing-pdf.description: Demonstrates how to protect a PDF with Aspose.Pdf by allowing printing but disabling content copying using encryption and permission settings.

remove-extended-usage-rights-from-signed.title: Remove Extended Usage Rights from Signed PDF
remove-extended-usage-rights-from-signed.description: Demonstrates loading a signed PDF with PdfFileSignature, removing any extended usage rights, and saving the updated document.

check-pdf-extended-usage-rights.title: Check PDF for Extended Usage Rights
check-pdf-extended-usage-rights.description: Shows how to bind a PDF with PdfFileSignature and determine if it contains extended usage rights using the ContainsUsageRights method.

remove-usage-rights-verify.title: Check and Remove PDF Usage Rights
remove-usage-rights-verify.description: The example binds a PDF to a PdfFileSignature, checks for existing usage rights, removes them if present, saves the result, and then verifies that the rights have been removed.

encrypt-pdf-with-password-and-capture-ex.title: Encrypt PDF with AES‑256 and Permissions using Aspose.Pdf
encrypt-pdf-with-password-and-capture-ex.description: Demonstrates loading a PDF, applying AES‑256 encryption with user/owner passwords, setting specific permissions, and saving the encrypted document while handling exceptions.

set-pdf-privilege-allow-exceptions-false.title: Modify PDF Permissions with Aspose.Pdf
set-pdf-privilege-allow-exceptions-false.description: Loads a PDF document, sets specific permissions (print, extract, modify), encrypts it using RC4 128‑bit, and saves the updated file.

encrypt-pdf-to-memory-stream.title: Encrypt PDF and Load into MemoryStream for Network Transmission
encrypt-pdf-to-memory-stream.description: Demonstrates loading a PDF, applying AES‑256 encryption with user and owner passwords, saving it temporarily, and reading the encrypted file into a MemoryStream ready for network transfer.

encrypt-pdf-from-byte-array.title: Encrypt PDF from Byte Array
encrypt-pdf-from-byte-array.description: Loads a PDF from a byte array, applies AES‑256 encryption with user and owner passwords, and returns the encrypted PDF as a byte array.

encrypt-pdf-with-user-password.title: Encrypt PDF with User Password Only
encrypt-pdf-with-user-password.description: Demonstrates how to encrypt a PDF using only a user password while leaving the owner password undefined, and sets basic permissions before saving the file.

apply-password-protection-to-pdf.title: Apply Password Protection to PDF with AES‑256 Encryption
apply-password-protection-to-pdf.description: Shows how to load an existing PDF, set user and owner passwords, define allowed permissions, encrypt the document using AES‑256, and save the protected file without recreating the document object.

retrieve-pdf-encryption-algorithm.title: Retrieve PDF Encryption Algorithm (Placeholder)
retrieve-pdf-encryption-algorithm.description: Demonstrates how to check if a PDF is encrypted and obtain its encryption algorithm using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfFileInfo, with a fallback placeholder when the property is unavailable.

validate-pdf-encryption-and-decrypt.title: Validate PDF Encryption and Decrypt with Aspose.Pdf
validate-pdf-encryption-and-decrypt.description: Demonstrates how to use Aspose.Pdf's Facades API to determine if a PDF is encrypted before attempting decryption, and then decrypts the document with a password when needed.

batch-encrypt-pdf-files.title: Batch Encrypt PDF Files with User and Owner Passwords
batch-encrypt-pdf-files.description: Demonstrates how to encrypt every PDF in a folder using Aspose.Pdf by applying the same user and owner passwords, setting specific permissions, and saving the encrypted files to an output directory.

batch-decrypt-pdfs-owner-passwords.title: Batch Decrypt PDFs Using Owner Passwords
batch-decrypt-pdfs-owner-passwords.description: Shows how to read a configuration file and decrypt multiple encrypted PDF files by providing the owner password, saving each as an unencrypted PDF.

batch-update-pdf-user-passwords.title: Update PDF User Passwords in Bulk
batch-update-pdf-user-passwords.description: Iterates through a folder of PDF files, re‑encrypts each document with a standardized user password and predefined permissions, overwriting the original files.

update-pdf-owner-password.title: Update PDF Owner Password While Preserving User Password
update-pdf-owner-password.description: Demonstrates how to batch‑process PDF files, keeping each document's existing user password while applying a new owner password using Aspose.Pdf encryption APIs.

conditional-pdf-encryption-based-on-file.title: Encrypt PDFs Using Filename-Based CryptoAlgorithm
conditional-pdf-encryption-based-on-file.description: Shows how to encrypt multiple PDF files with Aspose.Pdf, selecting the CryptoAlgorithm (AES‑256, AES‑128, or RC4) based on naming conventions and applying common permissions.

report-pdf-encryption-algorithms.title: Generate PDF Encryption Report
report-pdf-encryption-algorithms.description: Scans a directory of PDF files, uses Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfFileInfo to determine if each PDF is encrypted and (when available) the encryption algorithm, then writes a CSV‑style report.

encrypt-pdf-rc4-128-print-edit-privilege.title: Encrypt PDF with RC4‑128 and Allow Printing and Editing
encrypt-pdf-rc4-128-print-edit-privilege.description: The example loads a PDF, combines permission flags to allow printing and content modification, encrypts the document with RC4‑128 using user and owner passwords, and saves the encrypted file.

conditional-decrypt-modify-pdf.title: Conditionally Decrypt and Modify PDF with Aspose.Pdf
conditional-decrypt-modify-pdf.description: The example checks if a PDF is encrypted, opens it with a password when needed, adds a text fragment to the first page, and saves the modified document.

encrypt-decrypt-pdf-roundtrip.title: Encrypt and Decrypt PDF with AES‑256 and Verify Round‑Trip
encrypt-decrypt-pdf-roundtrip.description: Demonstrates applying AES‑256 encryption to a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, decrypting it, and comparing SHA‑256 hashes to confirm that the original and decrypted files are identical.

encrypt-pdfs-with-performance-timing.title: Encrypt PDFs and Log Encryption Time
encrypt-pdfs-with-performance-timing.description: Shows how to load multiple PDF files, encrypt each with user and owner passwords, and measure the encryption duration using a Stopwatch for performance monitoring.

encrypt-pdf-aes256-upload.title: Encrypt PDF with AES‑256 and Upload to Azure Blob Storage
encrypt-pdf-aes256-upload.description: Demonstrates how to encrypt a PDF using AES‑256 with Aspose.Pdf, save the encrypted file, and upload it to an Azure Blob Storage container.

decrypt-pdf-using-owner-password-azure-k.title: Decrypt PDF Using Owner Password from Azure Key Vault
decrypt-pdf-using-owner-password-azure-k.description: Demonstrates retrieving an owner password from Azure Key Vault and using Aspose.Pdf to open, decrypt, and save an encrypted PDF document.

change-pdf-passwords-from-csv.title: Change PDF User and Owner Passwords from CSV
change-pdf-passwords-from-csv.description: Reads a CSV file containing PDF paths and new passwords, then updates each PDF's user and owner passwords using Aspose.Pdf encryption features.

encrypt-pdf-stream-rc4-40.title: Encrypt PDF Stream with RC4‑40 using Aspose.Pdf
encrypt-pdf-stream-rc4-40.description: Shows how to load a PDF from a stream, apply RC4‑40 encryption with user and owner passwords, and return the encrypted PDF as a new memory stream.

pdf-encryption-summary.title: Generate PDF Encryption Summary CSV
pdf-encryption-summary.description: Scans PDFs in a folder, uses Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfFileInfo to detect encryption, and writes a CSV file listing each file’s encryption status, algorithm placeholder, and permissions.

pdf-decryption-failure-wrong-owner-passw.title: Test Decryption Fails with Incorrect Owner Password
pdf-decryption-failure-wrong-owner-passw.description: Creates an encrypted PDF, then verifies that opening it with a wrong owner password throws an InvalidPasswordException.

directory-watcher-pdf-encryption-service.title: Directory Watcher PDF Encryption Service
directory-watcher-pdf-encryption-service.description: Shows how to monitor a folder for new PDF files, encrypt each PDF with user and owner passwords using Aspose.Pdf, and move the encrypted files to a secure archive.
